title: Modern Cave Dweller
description: A resource pack that changes Gargin's Cave Dweller with a new model and textures to look more like something that belongs in the modern game.
body:
This a remodel and retexture of [Alessandrv's fabric port](https://modrinth.com/mod/cave-dweller-fabric) (and others) of [Gargin's Cave Dweller](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cave-dweller) that intends to make the dweller more 'modern' and 'serious' while sticking somewhat to the orginal design.

I was _inspired_ by the Cave Dweller Addon by XP studios (for bedrock edition) for the design. The focus was around making the cave dweller fit in better with the modern game, and add to the 'horror' aspect by making the dweller look more... intimidating rather than a bit 'goofy'. And I didn't want to take a route similar to that of [Alternate Cave Dweller by BurritoBandit28](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alternate-cavedweller) or [Cave Dweller Remodel by TheRebelT](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cave-dweller-remodel), and _totally_ change the design. I also very subtly changed a few animations to improve them and better fit the new model.
